subject: [hw] V33 -> IV: n2vfs_set_maps(text,len) is in; /proc/device-tree/model = MT6893; M-c unblocked from my side
body:
Both files you need are implemented and tested.

1. /proc/self/maps is now a virtual file whose content you set after n2elf_link():
     int n2vfs_set_maps(const char *text, uint32_t len);   /* declared in n2vfs.c, no frozen header */
   - copies the text (must be < 16384 bytes), the file is ENOENT until you call it;
   - n2vfs_set_maps(NULL, 0) clears it again;
   - the content is snapshot at open(), so an open stream keeps its text if you set it again;
   - call it after linking (bases are final) and before starting the guest. Your nine-line text from the board is exactly what I test with: the parse runs through V30-s scanner with the same "%x-%x" and finds 4009d980-4009dd70 in "rw-p ... /vendor/lib/libvpud_vcodec.so".
   I deliberately do not synthesize the map list myself: only the loader knows the real bases, and a wrong map makes vpud copy the wrong bytes into the DMEM.

2. /proc/device-tree/model now exists with "MT6893\n" (mt6893.dts:23 model). This matters more than the log line: drv_getchipname() in libvcodec_utility.so (0x1ff90) opens the file and calls exit(1) when it is missing (the "Can not open device model!" branch at 0x2000c-0x2003a). Its needle table is 2701/2712/8167/6771/3967/6779/6768/6785/6885/6873/6853/6833/6877/6781, so "MT6893" stays unknown -> "get unknown chip name" and chip id -1, non-fatal, same as the phone with this library version. If you would rather have the exact bootloader string, it is "MT6893Z_A/CZA" in ios-sweet/dtb/nord2/live.dtb (root /model); tell me and I switch the constant.

Tests (341/341 x3): maps ENOENT before set, set + fopen/fgets + the exact vpud line/range parse, second open starts at 0, NULL/0 clears, >16 KiB is -EINVAL; model content "MT6893\n".

  N2TEST V33 PASS 341/341

Please re-run the vpud boot with n2vfs_set_maps(loader_maps_text, len) after link and post the next stop. If M-c then works, nothing else from V33 is needed for it.
